title: Triternate
summary: TRITERN'ATE, adjective [Latin tres, three, and ternate.] Having three biternate leaves, or the divisions of a triple petiole subdivided into threes; a species of superdecompound leaf.

inlines.v: TRITERN'ATE, adjective [Latin tres, three, and ternate.] Having three biternate leaves, or the divisions of a triple petiole subdivided into threes; a species of superdecompound leaf.
